cue: Before first invocation of any workspace script whose flags/modes are unknown
lesson: Run --help (or skim the header) before the first real call; if a first call fails, diagnose and retry once with a changed flag (e.g., sandbox vs. in-process mode) rather than abandoning the script or repeating the same call
evidence: Reference trajectory burned two failed sandbox-mode script calls, while the candidate's check-help-first path discovered the --in host flag with zero wasted calls
